traces.consumers: current, last-good, sticky, request artifact copies; FrozenDictionary article/list/taxonomy and HTML base/overlay/removed indexes
traces.releaseEvent: Managed backing becomes GC-eligible only after all strong artifact, index and request references disappear; weak retirement references do not release native backing
traces.capacityModel: PublicHotReadResidentAccounting upper bound; raw/br/gzip/template arrays plus object/index estimates; not an exact physical allocation ledger
traces.frequency: Build/publication, HTML delta/compaction and overlapping generations
traces.asyncEscape: BodyWriter.WriteAsync ValueTask and nonce template writes; awaiting a write is not an explicit native lease
traces.migrationDisposition: candidate-only; no replacement before lease/completion and byte-oracle acceptance
traces.observationHeadroom: Retain managed behavior; observe build/current/LKG/sticky/overlay/reader overlap without claiming native accounting

traces.consumers: PublicAotCacheEntryBinaryCodec and its decoded-entry cache; bounded memory LRU; file metadata cache; caller entry references
traces.releaseEvent: ArrayPool raw buffer returned in finally after decode; decoded entries and caller copies have independent managed lifetimes
traces.capacityModel: Requested stream.Length; actual rented raw.Length may exceed request; FileStream 64 KiB buffer; decoded entry/string/template estimates are separate
traces.frequency: Cold file reads; unchanged metadata avoids repeated decoding
traces.asyncEscape: FileStream.ReadAsync and publication/recovery WriteAsync await completion; cancellation enters finally only after awaited I/O returns
traces.migrationDisposition: candidate-only; existing artifact publication remains the journal authority
traces.observationHeadroom: Pool capacity, decoded cache, LRU, metadata and caller references must all remain in denominator

traces.consumers: Per-policy partitions, LRU, typed decoder read leases, caller-owned raw snapshots
traces.releaseEvent: Entry retirement stops acquisition; clear only after final read lease and pin hold; store Dispose retires entries
traces.capacityModel: Entry logical byte length and actual array capacity plus store descriptors; policy/global ceilings already exist
traces.frequency: Cache publication, read, invalidation, eviction and shutdown
traces.asyncEscape: ReadLease memory manager and pins; raw port snapshot copies escape independently
traces.eligibilityOwner: CachePolicyRegistry and each existing cache policy data owner
traces.migrationDisposition: excluded from spill/device pending individual public/private policy classification
traces.observationHeadroom: Retain per-policy limits and measure actual capacity; this inventory does not control third-party Redis memory

traces.consumers: OwnedAedsFrameReadLease, LeaseMemoryManager pins and owned frame cache ports
traces.releaseEvent: Retire stops new leases; ReleaseReadLease and pin disposal detach backing; final callback/ArrayPool.Return only after last hold
traces.capacityModel: Length distinct from Capacity; pool Rent actual array capacity and growth overlap count separately
traces.asyncEscape: Leased MemoryManager views and pins; producer disposal cannot free a transferred frame
traces.eligibilityOwner: Existing frame producer classification and cache policy owner
traces.migrationDisposition: candidate-only; arbitrary AEDS payload is not automatically public
traces.observationHeadroom: Retain requires-clear contract and original final-release capacity callback; reserve separately from pool occupancy

traces.consumers: NotificationStreamConnection queues and NotificationStreamFramePump; one Retain per accepted fanout target
traces.releaseEvent: Rejected/consumed target releases retain; zero count returns pool with clearArray true. Pump copies bytes to PipeWriter then releases frame; transport owns the copied bytes
traces.capacityModel: Frame.Length distinct from rented buffer.Length; per-connection queue bytes and writer copy capacity remain separate
traces.asyncEscape: Connection queues retain frame; PipeWriter.GetSpan copies data before frame.Release; flushing owns separate transport buffers
traces.eligibilityOwner: Notification stream audience/admission and original message delivery owners
traces.migrationDisposition: excluded from public spill/device/deduplication; preserve private audience and delivery classification
traces.observationHeadroom: Observe queued/in-flight/backlog and framework transport headroom; no second delivery authority

traces.consumers: Read models, cache projections and asynchronous mutation/invalidation scopes
traces.releaseEvent: Managed rows/lists released by GC after query caller, projections and closures drop references; provider pool/materialization internals remain third-party
traces.capacityModel: ToListAsync list capacity, entities/strings, projected arrays and provider internal buffers; requested rows do not equal allocated capacity
traces.asyncEscape: ToListAsync Tasks and downstream projection/invalidation closures
traces.eligibilityOwner: ArticleService public/private read policy and established database owner
traces.migrationDisposition: excluded from spill until per-query classification; durable database rows are not a cache-tier migration target
traces.observationHeadroom: Preserve DB admission; observe provider/process headroom without claiming governance of SqlSugar/Npgsql internal allocations
